name: LoRa-E22T
description: Arduino library for EByte E22-T series LoRa modules (SX1262/SX1268). Supports all six E22-T variants across 230/400/900 MHz bands at 22/30 dBm. Provides full configuration API, Transparent and Fixed addressing, Wake-on-Radio, hardware encryption, and RSSI reporting. All operations return typed status codes for straightforward error handling.
